translated_title: When a Certain Argentine Right Hates Mexicans
original_title: Cuando cierta derecha argentina odia a los mexicanos
author: Fernando Buen Abad Domínguez
meta_description: "There is no spontaneous Argentine-Mexican conflict; there is a transnational circulation of narratives produced by influence networks, political consultancies, media, and algorithms that turn any disagreement between leaders into antagonism between peoples. Hondurasgate, for example."
